description: National Physical Plannning Department - Asirikanda Purana Rajamaha Viharaya Sacred Area and Nagalena Rajamaha Viharaya Sacred Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land-related matters, specifically the declaration of a specific area of land (109.9858 hectares comprising multiple lots) as an "Urban Development Area" called "Asirikanda Purana Rajamaha Viharaya Sacred Area" under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. The document contains detailed land descriptions, lot numbers, boundaries, and survey information, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or organizational matter.
